study: Rodriguez-Lloveras H et al., Thyroid 2025;35(5):494-507 (PMID 40045915, doi 10.1089/thy.2024.0303)
repository_or_source: University of Groningen repository via CORE (core.ac.uk/download/686443202.pdf)
initial_reason_for_interest: An ETA-meeting abstract was reported to describe EPIC-array thyroid samples including radioiodine-avid and refractory metastatic disease; flagged as the only plausible methylome x RAI-avidity x prognosis cohort
exclusion_reason: Full-text review confirmed the study reports no patient-level radioiodine treatment, uptake, response or refractoriness variable, and no public molecular-data accession. Term counts in the full text: radioiodine 1 (introduction background only), RAI 0, refractory 0, accession 0, deposit 0, GSE 0, repository 0. The design contrasts metastatic versus non-metastatic differentiated thyroid cancer, not iodine handling.

study: Morton LM et al., Science 2021 (Chernobyl radiation-related PTC)
initial_reason_for_interest: Large thyroid cohort (n=440) with WGS, RNA-seq, miRNA-seq, SNP array and EPIC methylation; assumed to carry iodine-related treatment records
molecular_data: WGS, RNA-seq, miRNA-seq, SNP array, methylation
exclusion_reason: Phenotype dictionaries (pht011227, pht011228) contain seven subject variables only: ID, exposure status, sex, age at surgery, age at exposure, fallout dose, diagnosis. The cohort records radiation EXPOSURE dose, not therapeutic radioiodine. No treatment, staging, recurrence or vital-status variable exists.

initial_reason_for_interest: Tissue resource behind the Chernobyl genomic studies
exclusion_reason: Data dictionary limited to age, sex, age at operation, oblast and I-131 fallout exposure dose. No therapeutic radioiodine, treatment, recurrence or follow-up fields.

study: Fukushima Health Management Survey thyroid sub-studies (Mitsutake 2015; Iyama 2017; Iwadate 2020)
initial_reason_for_interest: Exposed-population thyroid cohort with molecular sub-studies
exclusion_reason: Surgical case series reporting driver mutations; no radioiodine treatment or outcome variable in any abstract; no deposited dataset found in GEO or the Japanese archives.

study: Marshall Islands and Nevada Test Site downwinder cohorts
exclusion_reason: Epidemiological and dosimetry cohorts with no tumour molecular characterisation at all.

initial_reason_for_interest: Imaging-genomics route to post-therapy radioiodine scans
exclusion_reason: Six patients, CT and FDG-PET only. No I-131 whole-body scan or I-124 PET series exists in TCIA, and no public collection pairs radioiodine imaging with molecular data.

study: Industry IPD platforms (Vivli, CSDR, YODA) for SELECT, DECISION, COSMIC-311, LIBRETTO-001, ARROW, NAVIGATE
initial_reason_for_interest: Large RAI-refractory trial cohorts with biomarker sub-studies
therapeutic_RAI_variable: partly (refractory status is an eligibility criterion)
exclusion_reason: Lilly and Roche state explicitly that genomic, imaging and exploratory biomarker data are excluded from shareable packages; Roche additionally prohibits linking shared data to external genomic repositories. Exelixis has no IPD-sharing commitment. Only clinical datasets are obtainable.

study: Thyroid DNA-methylation series in GEO (GSE97466, GSE107738, GSE86961, GSE121377, GSE233560, GSE256293, GSE312914/296440/312587, GSE51090, GSE72729/72730 and others)
initial_reason_for_interest: Methylation is the proposed silencing mechanism for the eight-gene panel
exclusion_reason: Every thyroid methylation series retrieved by E-utilities carries only histology, stage, demographic or driver-genotype fields. No series exposes any radioiodine-related characteristic. This is a confirmed absence, not a search gap.

study: Thyroid cancer cell lines with radioiodide uptake assays (DepMap / CCLE linkage)
initial_reason_for_interest: Functional iodide uptake as a mechanistic readout for the panel
exclusion_reason: No public table of measured radioiodide uptake across thyroid lines exists. More fundamentally, 60 authenticated thyroid cancer lines are profoundly dedifferentiated in culture regardless of derivation (Saiselet et al., PMC6522280), so panel-gene variation needed for the correlation is absent by construction.

study: cBioPortal thyroid studies (thyroid_mskcc_2016, thyroid_gatci_2024, thca_tcga*, thpa_tcga_gdc)
initial_reason_for_interest: Obvious first place to look for RAI annotation
exclusion_reason: Complete clinical-attribute enumeration for every thyroid study shows no radioiodine field. Note this is why the TCGA radiation records were missed for the life of the project: they exist only in the GDC BCR Biotab layer, not in the curated cBioPortal view. The study id thyroid_mskcc_2022 does not exist.

study: Redifferentiation trials other than E-MTAB-12837/12900 (selumetinib Ho 2013; dabrafenib Rothenberg 2015; vemurafenib Dunn 2019; MERAIODE; ERRITI; SEL-I-METRY)
initial_reason_for_interest: Trials that directly measure restored iodine uptake
exclusion_reason: No redifferentiation trial other than E-MTAB-12837/12900 deposited raw molecular data in any public repository. Per-patient information exists only inside paper tables, and ERRITI states explicitly that data are available only on request.

study: Jankovic Miljus J et al., J Clin Endocrinol Metab 2022;107(5):1280-1293 (PMID 35022762) — GSE173248
initial_reason_for_interest: Found by phenotype-based re-mining rather than keyword search: sample characteristics contain "Complete Remission" versus "Persistent/Recurrent Disease" with no occurrence of the words radioiodine, RAI or iodine anywhere in the record
full_text_obtained: yes (GEO SOFT + processed xlsx downloaded and opened; paper via PubMed/EuropePMC)
molecular_data: serum small-RNA-seq, Illumina NextSeq 500 (GPL18573); 2,580 mature miRNAs, 7,485 small-RNA loci, 92 putative miRNAs; NO mRNA of any kind
decision: EXCLUDED from panel testing; RETAINED in inventory
exclusion_reason: Serum cell-free small RNA, not tumour mRNA, so a tissue differentiation-score gene set cannot be scored on it even in principle. 22 GSMs = 11 patients x 2 timepoints (basal Thy0 versus 72h post-rhTSH Thy2), not 22 patients. Three mutually inconsistent cohort sizes exist: GEO overall_design says 37 patients, the paper says 30, the deposited subset is 11 — unresolved. Field names are transposed in the submission: the field labelled "rhtsh stimulation:" holds the disease-status group and the field labelled "cancer recurrence:" holds the TSH timepoint, which will silently mis-map any name-based parser. Radioiodine treatment is stated in the paper Methods for the n=30 cohort but is not an encoded variable in the deposit; it must not be described as an RAI cohort.
